PreToolUse.hook: bash -c 'input=$(cat); file=$(echo "$input" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty"); if echo "$file" | grep -qE "(^|/)\.env($|\.)" && ! echo "$file" | grep -qE "\.env\.example$"; then echo "{\"decision\": \"block\", \"reason\": \"Access to .env files is blocked to protect secrets.\"}"; else echo "{\"decision\": \"approve\"}"; fi'
